items.title: Charles River Laboratories (CRL) Expands Virtual Control Group Use In Toxicology Studies
items.summary: Charles River Laboratories International (NYSE:CRL) agreed to deploy its Virtual Control Group database for Ipsen to support toxicology studies and reduce animal use. The Ipsen collaboration uses AI powered analytics and historical control data to replace some live control groups in preclinical testing. items.title: Labcorp Holdings (LH) Expands HPV Testing While Teaming With Regulators On Drug Safety
items.summary: Labcorp Holdings (NYSE: LH) partnered with Waters Corporation to deploy the BD Onclarity HPV Assay across its national laboratory network. The BD Onclarity HPV Assay rollout is designed to broaden access to advanced cervical cancer screening for patients across the United States. Labcorp announced a collaboration with the FDA and Charles River Laboratories to refine methods used to evaluate drug abuse potential.
